## Figure B.22 — Internal density of the final themes

```{r theme-internal-density, fig.width=12, fig.height=14, fig.align="center"}
theme_density_data <- theme_data %>%
  mutate(theme_en = unname(theme_translations[theme_id]))

# Interromper a execução caso algum tema não tenha tradução
untranslated_density_themes <- theme_density_data %>%
  filter(
    is.na(theme_en)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    theme_id,
    theme
  )

if (nrow(untranslated_density_themes) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The following themes do not have an English translation: ",
      paste(
        untranslated_density_themes$theme_id,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}

# Calcular a densidade e preparar os rótulos em inglês
theme_density_data <- theme_density_data %>%
  mutate(
    density = codes / clusters,

    theme_key = paste0(
      as.character(srq),
      "__",
      theme_id
    ),

    theme_axis_label = paste0(
      theme_id,
      " — ",
      stringr::str_wrap(
        theme_en,
        width = 34
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    srq,
    density
  )

# Fixar a ordem dos temas dentro dos painéis
theme_density_levels <- theme_density_data$theme_key

theme_density_labels <- stats::setNames(
  theme_density_data$theme_axis_label,
  theme_density_data$theme_key
)

theme_density_data <- theme_density_data %>%
  mutate(
    theme_key = factor(
      theme_key,
      levels = theme_density_levels
    )
  )

maximum_theme_density <- max(
  theme_density_data$density,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


theme_density_plot <- ggplot(
  theme_density_data,
  aes(
    x = density,
    y = theme_key
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      fill = srq,
      size = clusters
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "navyblue",
    stroke = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = density +
        maximum_theme_density * 0.025,

      label = sprintf(
        "%.1f",
        density
      )
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.1,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ srq,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = srq_palette,
    name = "Research Question"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(
      4,
      10
    ),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(
      n = 4
    ),
    name = "Incorporated Clusters"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      maximum_theme_density * 1.18
    ),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(
      n = 6
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = theme_density_labels
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Internal Density of the Final Themes",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Density represents the average number of codes per incorporated cluster; ",
      "point size represents the number of clusters"
    ),
    x = "Codes per Incorporated Cluster",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 8.5
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 10.5
    ),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "bottom",

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    panel.spacing = grid::unit(
      1,
      "cm"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 35,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none",

    size = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  )


print(theme_density_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "figure_theme_internal_density.png",
  plot = theme_density_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 300
)
```
